style.styleTitle: Nkuku Set of 4 Athardi Drop Christmas Baubles
style.toneOfVoice: With its elegant twisted drop shape along with antique silver tone, the Athardi bauble offers a refined, decorative touch to festive decor. This elongated spiral design adds movement and a hint of drama, with the aged mercury finish reflects soft, flickering light, creating a classic sense of warmth and sophistication. Whether hung on a tree or styled as part of a table setting, it offers vintage charm with a contemporary edge. Each Sari tie is one of a kind, so the piece you receive will vary slightly from the images shown, due to its individual character and handmade. Dimensions(mm): . Height: 100 . Width: 30 . Depth: 30.
